plain_language_verdict: Even a theoretical perfect expected-value predictor is wrong on about 35.0% of papers because citation arrivals follow an over-dispersed Negative Binomial process (phi=3.86). 44.3% of papers sit so close to cohort percentile boundaries that their true tier is governed by stochastic arrival variance rather than deterministic features. Consequently, 80-85% accuracy on this 3-tier task is mathematically impossible with 2 years of observed data.
